title: Big Miller in Honolulu and Canada
summary: They discuss singer Big Miller, who stayed in Hawaii and may now be in Canada, for John Hendricks's project.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working with Sinatra: bands, Vegas and the Sands

blocks.x: We were talking about Big Miller (inaudible) the other day. I told you John Hendricks was looking for him. He worked in Hawaii for a while -- Honolulu didn't he? (inaudible).
Yeah, he was over there for a long while. In fact, when I went back over there, he was there. He wasn't there when I left, when I first left.
In the '60s-- what, '62, -3, he went a hit single over there and on his way back he went on a tour to Australia and had, I think (inaudible) stop in Honolulu, and he never came back, apparently.

Well, that's what happens to Big lot of times. I think he got stuck up in Canada somewhere now, you know. I don't know just where, but I can kind of get a kind of line on him from some musicians I know up there if I -- I'm going to write them and find out, let them know that John Hendricks is interested, and if I can find out that, where he is, I can write you back and let you know.
Sure. And John would like to use him on "Evolution of the Blues" in New York. from you (inaudible).
Well, he's good on that album, you know. I really liked him. I got the album, you know, and I really enjoy him, you know.
Was he singing? (inaudible) -- he wrote me once from Honolulu and said he was managing a club or something.
He was managing the club. I think he was singing too. He was managing and singing or something like that. Some -- couple of girls was running a club over there.
Yeah. Yeah, he was singing and managing that club.
He was singing in Canada, so far as you know?
I heard he was. Somebody -- I forgot who told me, how long ago. It's been over a year since somebody -- or longer since -- but it's probably been since you've heard anything about it.

And it wasn't in a big city. It was somewhere up past Vancouver, farther up north there. It was some -- they told me the place. I forgot the place now, but I can find out from some of the musicians around Vancouver perhaps, you know. They would know.
